description: Configurable performance baselines. A baseline is a recorded p95 for one platform, not a claim that platforms have equal timings. The default tolerance is 0.25, so a 1.5x regression fails. A required metric with no measurement, too few runs, a unit mismatch, a non-finite value, or no platform baseline also fails. Pass --enforce-budgets to make the status govern the process exit code.

web-chromium.label: Headless Chromium through the production static build
web-chromium.source: Calibrated from GitHub Actions run 41933449566 (2026-11-04, ubuntu-24.04, 5 runs) and a local production build. Update only with reviewed evidence.

documentSwitch.note: The recorded run measured about 2.5 s with 900 stored documents. This is the reported responsiveness defect. The baseline prevents a large regression before a fix lands.
